content:
**Canned Coffee** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

## Gameplay[edit]

A metal can filled with ready-to-heat instant coffee. It is quickly brewed by adding hot water or milk to the preserved powder. According to the label, it produces 16 fluid ounces of coffee and may cause a rash.

## Locations[edit]

- One can be found on the roof of the Crab Shack near the Toxic Dried Lakebed.
- Sunday Brothers' Cabin, in the locked basement on the shelving in the center of the room.
- Two can be found at the South Mountain Lookout, one on a shelf in the shack and another at the top of the tower.
- On a kitchen counter in the Flatwoods Tavern.
- Several in the large shack just west of Mosstown.
- Randomly found in food containers with the Can Do! perk.
- Two can be found on shelves at Cobbleton Farm.
